title: My Safe Place — the Hole
content: I recently dreamt of this place again, after 15years. Always appearing in dreams where I'm running away or afraid, I often find myself seeking out and crawling into a small dark tunnel that leads to a small dark empty room. This is always a place of refuge and safety, not necessarily peace, but always neutrality. I think this was my personal safe zone as a child. Recently I dreamt of it again, but this time I wasn't running. My friend was running — and I was trying to lead him to my safe place. He was afraid of the dark, and refused to go, but I remembered this place, and instinctively I knew it as safe. Instead, he ran towards a door that had light shining through, a parking garage I believe. Where he then collided with the assailant that he was running from.
